oauth_account_id.description: Existing connected-account ID to re-link. When provider_id is omitted, the server derives it from this account.

account_purpose.description: Optional connected-account capability request. Canonical values are drive, youtube, and drive_youtube; the Control Panel also accepts its documented compatibility aliases and normalizes the effective scopes.

redirect_after.description: Safe local path only; implementations must reject absolute or protocol-relative URLs.
